node.statement: Self-contained auxiliary correction fact (using only the root hypotheses, the two allowed polar externals, and the registered definitions): write e=epsilon_r and t=delta-C_pol*(e*delta+delta^2). Then e,delta<=1/64 and t>600e; for every A,B in calU, both A^dagger and A bold-dot B belong to S_delta, u_delta(A^dagger),u_delta(A bold-dot B) lie in calU, and ||u_delta(A^dagger)-A^dagger||<=84e and ||u_delta(A bold-dot B)-A bold-dot B||<=84e.
